min_booking_notice.description: Applies to the bookings customers make themselves — online, WhatsApp, booking requests. From the front desk you can always book for right now.

auto_confirm_online.label: Confirm bookings made by the customer automatically
auto_confirm_online.description: When on, an appointment the customer booked herself — online or through an automation such as WhatsApp — is created already confirmed, so nobody has to accept it one by one. Turn it off to review every one of them before it counts.
